solutionSql:
SELECT s.id,
       c.name AS customer_name,
       w.city AS origin_city
FROM shipments s
JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
JOIN routes r ON r.id = s.route_id
JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = r.origin_id
WHERE s.id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
ORDER BY s.id;
notes: Origin is the route's origin warehouse, reached through routes.origin_id, and the ticket's where-it-leaves-from wording matches that. Each shipment's route resolves to a city.
